Command `cd /workspace && cat > candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[{"step":1,"file":"src-vul/curl_fuzzer/curl_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"data,size","code":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)","note":"Attacker-controlled raw bytes enter the fuzzer entrypoint as the candidate input."},{"step":2,"file":"src-vul/curl_fuzzer/curl_fuzzer_tlv.cc","function":"fuzz_get_tlv_comn","line":58,"var":"fuzz->state.data[fuzz->state.data_pos]","code":"raw = (TLV_RAW *)&fuzz->state.data[fuzz->state.data_pos];","note":"The input is interpreted as a TLV header and payload, so the bytes can steer curl options."},{"step":3,"file":"src-vul/curl_fuzzer/curl_fuzzer_tlv.cc","function":"fuzz_parse_tlv","line":93,"var":"tlv->type == TLV_TYPE_URL","code":"FSINGLETONTLV(fuzz, TLV_TYPE_URL, CURLOPT_URL);","note":"A TLV of type URL is converted into CURLOPT_URL, making the raw bytes control the request URL."},{"step":4,"file":"src-vul/curl_fuzzer/curl_fuzzer_tlv.cc","function":"fuzz_tlv_to_string","line":223,"var":"tlv->value","code":"memcpy(tlvstr, tlv->value, tlv->length);","note":"The URL TLV payload is copied into a NUL-terminated string that libcurl later consumes."},{"step":5,"file":"src-vul/curl_fuzzer/curl_fuzzer.cc","function":"fuzz_handle_transfer","line":null,"var":"fuzz.easy","code":"curl_easy_setopt(fuzz.easy, CURLOPT_URL, fuzz->url);","note":"The crafted URL is installed on the easy handle and drives protocol selection to IMAP/IMAPS."},{"step":6,"file":"src-vul/curl/lib/imap.c","function":"imap_state_listsearch_resp","line":1028,"var":"line[len]","code":"line[len] = '\n';","note":"During IMAP response handling, libcurl writes a newline into the fixed response buffer before forwarding it, which is the suspected stack-buffer-overflow write sink."}]
